title_in_battle: OFF. BattleView.tsx has NO game-title element. It has: enemy HP panel top-left, player HP panel bottom-right, move banner (move name only, e.g. Tackle), log, move buttons from MOVES_DB, Luigi Cube, Flee. Pokemon games do not show the game title in the middle of a battle, and the Pillow composites that put MOCHIICHAO / DIAMOND VERSION at the top of the battle were wrong. Title belongs only on the title screen / IntroSequence, never in battle.
